## Full candidate integration coverage — no samples
Inventory every configured agent, MCP assignment, model, Citadel link, and Tailscale link. OpenClaw applies per-agent MCP selection; Hermes retains global MCP access.
Real tool/model requests and every link must work. Missing coverage or NOT_TESTED blocks latest promotion. Each PDF section contains the full itemized results plus a short Astra summary.

## Docker Image Update Loop
**Layout only:** business execution remains disabled; existing conditions and tagging rules are preserved. Structured result collection is attached. Astra is selected through local LiteLLM.
Decision/endpoint checkpoints use the shared **Fedora45 Step Report - LLM and PDF** sub-workflow after every business step and selected decision branch. The reporter appends to one PDF per run and returns the original result unchanged.
**True = yes/pass; false = no/fail.** Errors and timeouts must also be reported before aborting or rolling back.

## 1. Check generators first, then freeze the baseline
Update yes → read-only OpenClaw/Hermes generator prechecks → stable tags and local pull → stable Quadlets → daemon-reload without restart → unchanged baseline → generator preparation below → remaining preflight and atomic commit.

## 2. Build and custom-patch tests
Build and track the same Action run → basic container checklist → own OpenClaw/Hermes patch regressions → full agent, MCP, model, Citadel, and Tailscale integration lane.

## 3. Deploy verified latest and send the accumulated report
Pull latest and verify its digest → latest Quadlets → daemon-reload → recreate containers → health check. Success and all failure outcomes converge on the final PDF delivery.

## 4. Rollback and failure outcomes
Restore stable Quadlets → daemon-reload → recreate from stable → verify recovery. Both successful recovery and failure lead to the final report.

## 5. Bounded script repair
Validation failure → remaining-attempt gate → AI correction → deterministic verification against captured/live input and historical fixtures → review → adoption → rerun version check. Every attempt is added to the same PDF.
